_notes: Copy to config.json. Only keys you want to change need to be here; the rest use defaults in bay_occupancy.py. min_box_area_frac = smallest truck box (fraction of the whole frame) that counts. *_confirm_count = consecutive rounds that must agree before a bay flips state (empty is higher so one missed detection can't flap it). MQTT publishes only on a confirmed change, retained, to <topic_prefix>/<bay>.
